title: Land Underwriter (10 Hours/Week ONLY)
description:
Land Underwriter (Part-Time | 10 Hours/Week | Remote)



Job Type: Part-Time (10 Hours per Week)

Location: Remote / Work from Home

Schedule: Flexible



About the Role



We are seeking a detail-oriented Land Underwriter to join our real estate investment team. In this role, you will analyze vacant land opportunities, conduct due diligence, and provide accurate underwriting reports to help our acquisitions team make informed purchasing decisions.



If you have experience evaluating vacant land and identifying profitable investment opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.



Responsibilities

Analyze vacant land deals and determine market value

Research comparable land sales (comps)

Calculate Maximum Allowable Offer (MAO)

Review zoning, land use, flood zones, wetlands, and property access

Research property ownership, taxes, liens, easements, and other due diligence items

Prepare underwriting reports and pricing recommendations

Collaborate with the acquisitions team to identify profitable land opportunities

Qualifications

Experience in land underwriting or vacant land analysis is preferred

Strong understanding of land valuation, comparable sales, and due diligence

Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills

Proficient in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

Detail-oriented, organized, and able to work independently

Excellent time management skills

Position Details

Part-Time (10 Hours per Week)

Flexible work schedule

Remote / Work-from-Home

Immediate start preferred

How to Apply



Please
 the following to 



Your Resume/CV

A brief summary of your experience in land underwriting or real estate

Only applicants with relevant experience will be considered.

title: Online Research & Historical Data Collection Assistant
description:
# Online Research & Historical Data Collection Assistant



I'm looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to collect **publicly available historical data (primarily from 2023–2025)** from various online platforms and organize it in Google Sheets.



This is a **data collection** role only. No analysis, decision-making, or reporting is required. You will receive a detailed SOP explaining exactly what information to collect and how to record it.



## Responsibilities



* Search for specific products across various online platforms.

* Collect publicly available historical data from **2023–2025**, where available.

* Record the requested information accurately in Google Sheets.

* Capture and upload screenshots as proof of the collected data.

* Follow the provided SOP carefully.

* Mark **N/F** if information cannot be found. Never guess or estimate.



## Requirements



* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong internet research skills.

* Comfortable using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.

* Able to follow detailed instructions precisely.

* Good written English.

* Reliable internet connection.



## Project Details



* Approximately **100 products**.

* The first batch will be assigned immediately.

* Additional batches will be assigned throughout the project.

* Each assigned batch should be completed within **48 hours**.

* The project is expected to last about **one month**, with the possibility of additional work if the collaboration goes well.



## Deliverables



For each assigned product:



* Complete the required fields in our Google Sheet.

* Upload all required screenshots to Google Drive.

* Ensure all collected data is accurate and supported by screenshots.



## To Apply



Please include:



1. A brief description of your experience with online research or data collection.

2. Your hourly rate.

3. Your estimated turnaround time for a batch of 10 products.

4. Start your application with the word **Panda** so I know you've read the entire job post.



I'm looking for someone who is organized, dependable, accurate, and able to follow instructions carefully.

title: Part-Time Senior WordPress & Elementor Developer
description:
KEY DETAILS

• Part-time; 40 – 50 hours per month

• C1 (Advanced) English, written and verbal

• Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.



ABOUT US  

Founded in 2011, Tempesta Media is an award-winning marketing technology company. We are the only demand-generation solution built exclusively for residential home services contractors that brings in larger, higher-quality projects.

With more than 400 customers served across the United States, Tempesta Media’s comprehensive suite of solutions includes Bullseye Effect™, Scale, and Dominate to serve the marketing needs of contractors.



RESPONSIBILITIES

We seek a self-motivated and experienced part-time, senior WordPress developer to support Tempesta Media’s web efforts and our diverse portfolio of clients. This is a hands-on role that focuses on the following areas: 



• WordPress and Elementor website creation, modification and management

• Siteground hosting management in the context of WordPress-powered websites



This part-time position requires full-cycle website development, QA and optimization. 



Specific responsibilities include the following:



• Set up new WordPress/Elementor website environment on Siteground, including spinning up new website/staging, installing WordPress, Elementor plugins, caching and themes/designs.

• Establish automated website backup schedule. 

• Implement server and site security best practices.

• Implement new website design, including UI from Figma and other files delivered by creative team.

• Implement website functionality or changes/optimizations, including forms, UX, content and SEO/AEO, as directed.

• Coordinate testing with project manager including unit and acceptance testing, and code documentation.

• Participate in regular tea
etings, providing insights and recommendations.



SKILLS

• A strong foundation in web development and an educational background with a related degree is required.

• A minimum of 5 years of WordPress development experience is required.

• A minimum of 3 years of hands-on Elementor experience is required. 

• An excellent foundation in front-end and back-end web development, including PHP, WordPress, DB (MySQL, MariaDB), JavaScript, and API integrations.

• Experience developing and optimizing WordPress plugins and themes.

• Ability to professionally communicate with all levels of users, both orally and in writing.

• Full website development lifecycle experience – from server setup all the way through to final testing, release and management.

• Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4.

• Experience converting Figma and PSD files to web pages.

• Experience implementing SEO and content optimization techniques in web pages at the direction of seasoned internal subject matter experts (SMEs).

• Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Loves learning new technology, approaches, and methodologies. 



This part-time position is expected to be 40 – 50 hours per month with flexibility on working time. We work by deadlines. You must be able to attend a weekly call at 10 AM CST (-06:00 GMT) on Mondays.



APPLYING FOR THE POSITION



All of the following are required to apply for this position. Those applications that do not have all of these items will not be considered.



• A short video introducing yourself is required. Include the phrase Tempesta Media.

• A brief cover letter describing what you learned about our company, your relevant experience, your desired hourly rate, and how you can immediately impact the company in your first 90 days.

• Your full resume. Highlight in yellow areas of skill or experience that you feel stands out or is especially relevant for this role.

title: Marketing Manager

Playground Garages develops and sells premium private garage condos — secure, climate-controlled, 24/7-access units that car collectors, hobbyists, and business owners own rather than rent. We're growing across multiple Colorado communities, and every unit we sell starts with a lead. Your job is to fill that pipeline.

This is a builder's seat: you'll own video, photo, and copy production, manage our social channels, and run paid digital campaigns across all three properties. You're equally comfortable editing a TikTok in the morning and reading a cost-per-lead report in the afternoon.



The single most important measure of success in this role is a high volume of qualified leads for our garage condo units.

What You'll Do

Content editing & production



Edit short- and long-form video (walkthroughs, drone footage, owner stories, ads) for social and web.

Edit and retouch photography of units, amenities, and events.

Write and edit copy in English — ad headlines, captions, landing pages,
, and listings — that's clear, persuasive, and on-brand.

Produce graphics and marketing assets in Canva (or comparable design tools).



Digital marketing & paid ads



Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns on Meta 
/Instagram), Google, and other digital ad platforms.

Manage budgets, targeting, and creative testing to drive down cost per qualified lead.

Track performance, build simple reports, and continuously improve based on the numbers.



Social media management



Own day-to-day management of Instagram, TikTok, and other social channels across all three properties.

Build content calendars, post consistently, and grow engaged local audiences.

Respond to comments and DMs, and route serious inquiries into the sales pipeline.



Lead generation



Build and optimize the full top-of-funnel: ads ? content ? landing pages ? lead forms.

Coordinate with the sales/ownership team so leads are followed up quickly and tracked to outcomes.

Requirements

Experience running paid digital ads on Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms.

Hands-on experience managing Instagram, TikTok, and other social media channels.

Fluent English (written and spoken).

Proficiency with Canva or comparable graphic design software.

Nice to Have

 marketing and basic CRM/landing-page tools.

Volume and quality of leads generated.

Cost per qualified lead.

Social audience growth and engagement.

Consistency and quality of published content.

Fully Scaled is a marketing and funnel-building agency helping coaches and online service businesses build high-converting sales systems. We produce video sales letters,
 ad creative, and YouTube content for clients across fitness, real estate, and high-ticket coaching niches. We're looking for a skilled video editor to join our team part-time.

- Editing raw footage into polished
/Instagram ad creative (hook-driven, scroll-stopping, optimized for short attention spans)

- Cutting down long-form YouTube videos, podcasts, or webinars into shorter highlight clips and cutdowns

- Adding captions, basic motion graphics, text overlays, and pacing edits that keep retention high

- Turning around edits on tight timelines without sacrificing quality

- Taking feedback and revisions quickly and applying them accurately

- Organizing and managing footage/project files efficiently



Requirements



Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro (required)

Proven experience editing
 ads and/or YouTube cutdowns please include a portfolio or reel

Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, and retention for short-form/paid social content

title: ERP Implementation Officer
description:
TASK LIST /ACTIVITIES:



A.) Leads the monitoring of system implementation

• Assist with the decision-making, on a strategic and operational level 

• Support learning, communication and advocacy processes 

• Accountable and follow-up to the project actors 

• Initiate capacity-building of the key actors



B.) In-charge of the management of system implementation

• Practice the Plan, Do, Check, Act/Adjust cycle.

• Establishes a flexible management system to achieve more consistent implementation of compliance, policies and processes.

C.) Leads the review  of processes

• Discuss the existing process with your team.

• Set metrics to measure success.

• Map out the current process.

• Get to the bottom of all variants.

• Review each individual step.

• Map a new process.

• Test the reworked process.

• Document and implement broadly

• Repeat, review, rework



D.) Run the documentation of processes

• Provides clear methods and processes to identify and prioritize risks

• Set and monitor goals

• Communicate those risks to employees and management, 

• Allocates the resources to mitigate them.

• Creates consistent processes and procedures that support personnel changes (e.g., transfers, promotions, retirements) 



E.) Leads the continuous improvement and streamlining of processes

• Shifts from a command-and-control, centrally driven function to one that depends heavily on teamwork and implementation of a common system

• Takes into consideration the necessary local differences and building better know-how at the facility level.

• Training of new personnel without causing disruption or gaps.



D.) Consistently coordinates with process owners 

• Establishes a common language for periodic calls and meetings among managers, facility managers, and executives, which yields better goal setting, priority ranking, and allocation of resources to the areas with greatest risk or the greatest opportunity to add business value.

• Empowers facilities to take responsibility for processes and compliance performance without waiting to be told “what” and “how”.

• Enables better collaboration and communication across a distributed company with many locations.



E.) Spearheads coordination with system providers

• Enables the selection and implementation of a robust information system capable of tracking and reporting on common activities and performance metrics across the company.

• Employs a design and implementation process that builds company know-how, captures/retains institutional knowledge, and enables ongoing improvement without having to continually reinvent the wheel.

• Allows for more consistent oversight and governance, yielding higher predictability and reliability.

title: Operations & CRM Systems Specialist (Wealthbox / Financial CRM)
description:
We are an established financial planning and wealth management practice with a 25-year history of success. We are looking for a brilliant Operations & CRM Systems Specialist to help us transition our institutional knowledge, deep client relationships, and intuitive business processes into a flawless, automated digital machine.



You will work directly with the Firm Owner and our Veteran Lead Assistant of 25 years to systematically extract our operational processes and build them out inside Wealthbox CRM and Box (Cloud Storage).



This is NOT a creative marketing role, nor is it a general administrative or data-entry gig. You will act as our Systems Architect. Your main objective is to map out every single step of our client lifecycle—from a prospect first putting their hand up to onboarding them as a paying, retained client—and ensure our systems talk to each other perfectly.  



Key Responsibilities & Scope of Work

CRM Workflow Architecture (Wealthbox):

Take raw processes and map them into precise, sequential, multi-step workflows inside Wealthbox. You will define triggers, assign roles, set due-date dependencies, and build conditional logic (if/then paths).



Box SOP Folder & Document Integration:

Organize our Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) inside Box. You will deeply embed links directly between systems: every Wealthbox task must link straight to the specific Box folder containing the exact
 templates, forms, and step-by-step documentation needed to complete that task.



Process Mapping & "Brain Dump" Extraction:

Review recorded screen-share videos (Loom recordings) and participate in live video syncs with the team. You must listen to how we currently operate, translate that into visual logic trees or outlines, and get approval before building them into production.



Template Optimization:

Standardize and organize canned
 templates, text snippets, and task checklists within Wealthbox so that client communication is unified and efficient.



Required Skills & Experience

Financial Services CRM Experience (Mandatory):

You must have direct, hands-on experience building out workflows, pipelines, and automation inside a financial services CRM. Experience with Wealthbox or Redtail is a major plus, but heavy experience with Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) or a deeply customized HubSpot/CRM is acceptable. You must understand how CRM logic transfers.



Excellent, Fluid English Communication:

You must be fully comfortable doing deep-dive conversational "brain dumps" over Zoom. You need to be able to hear a messy description of a process and confidently ask clarifying questions to find the logic.



Advanced Process Mapping & Logic:

You are an analytical, systems-first thinker. You think naturally in "logic trees" (e.g., If Step A happens, Step B triggers; but if X occurs, go to Step C instead).



Extreme Attention to Detail:

You are obsessed with neatness, consistent naming conventions, formatting, and ensuring that no link or task dependency is broken.



How to Apply 

We only hire professionals who read instructions thoroughly. If you want to be considered for this permanent position, please reply with:



Change the subject line of your application to: "Systems Builder Application: [Your Name]"



A brief 2-3 sentence summary of your experience building workflows in Wealthbox, Redtail, Salesforce, or other CRMs.



Applications that do not follow these three specific steps will be automatically filtered out.

title: Facebook Ads Media Buyer
description:
Read This Before You Apply



We are a UK-based lead generation agency that works exclusively with aesthetics clinics — skin clinics, laser hair removal centres, and medical spas. We run paid ad campaigns, build out full CRM systems in GoHighLevel, and automate the entire client journey from lead to booked appointment.



We are growing fast and we need a
 Ads Media Buyer who actually knows how to generate high-quality leads, not just cheap clicks.



This is not a role for someone who has "boosted a few posts" or relies entirely on broad targeting and hoping for the best. We need someone who understands campaign architecture, creative testing, offer positioning, and how to scale ad spend profitably in the aesthetics space.



If that is you, keep reading.



What You Will Be Doing



Your job is to own the ad accounts and drive the lead flow. That means:



•Campaign Management: Building, launching, and managing
/Instagram ad campaigns for multiple aesthetics clinics simultaneously



•Creative & Copy: Writing ad copy and selecting/directing creatives that actually convert in the aesthetics niche



•Testing & Optimization: Running rigorous A/B tests on audiences, creatives, and offers to drive down Cost Per Lead (CPL) while maintaining lead quality



•Data Analysis: Monitoring ROAS, CPL, and click-through rates daily, and making data-driven decisions to optimize performance



•Reporting: Providing clear, concise updates to the team and clients on campaign performance



•Platform Integration: Ensuring lead forms and pixels are correctly set up and firing into our GoHighLevel CRM



Who We Are Looking For



Must-Haves — Non-Negotiable:



•Proven
 Ads experience. You must have managed significant ad spend and can show us real results (screenshots of active accounts, ROAS, CPL).



•Lead generation expertise. E-commerce media buying is great, but we need someone who knows how to generate qualified leads for local service businesses.



•Strong copywriting skills. You know how to write direct-response copy that gets people to take action.



•Analytical mindset. You don't guess; you look at the data and know exactly what lever to pull when a campaign is underperforming.



•Excellent written English. You will be communicating with the team daily via Slack and writing ad copy for UK audiences.



•Reliable internet connection and a proper home office setup.



Strong Preferences — Green Flags:



•Aesthetics niche experience. If you have run ads for Botox, laser hair removal, or skin clinics before, you go straight to the top of the pile.



•Previous experience working inside a digital marketing agency managing multiple client accounts.



•Familiarity with GoHighLevel and how
 lead forms integrate with it.



•You are proactive — you spot ad fatigue before the client complains and you bring fresh creative ideas to the table.



What Working at Sargent Connects Looks Like



We are a small, fast-moving team. There is no micromanagement here — we care about the output, not the hours. You will be given clear targets, clear expectations, and the autonomy to get things done.



We are also serious about growth. If you perform and our clients win, your role and your compensation grow with the company. We are not looking for a short-term hire — we want someone who wants to build something with us.



How to Apply



Generic applications go straight to the bin. If you want this role, here is what you need to do:



1.Record a Loom video (2–3 minutes max):



•Introduce yourself and your media buying experience



•Walk us through a successful lead generation campaign you ran (show us the Ads Manager if possible) — explain the offer, the targeting, and the results



•Tell us what you think is the biggest mistake people make when running ads for local service businesses



No Loom video = automatic rejection. No exceptions.



HOW TO APPLY:



(Copy and paste)







We look forward to seeing what you can do.

About the role



We produce high-volume YouTube content — long-form videos and short-form clips — and we're looking for a fast, hyper-organized footage editor to handle the first and most important pass of every edit. Your job is to watch all the raw footage, cut out everything that doesn't work, and keep only the strongest, interesting moments. You'll prepare clean, organized selects and hand them off to our lead editor to finish.

This isn't a creative finishing role — it's a precision role. You find the gold in hours of footage and remove everything else, fast and cleanly. This role can grow into much more. If you're reliable and your work is strong, there's a clear path to take on bigger editing responsibilities over time — and I'll personally invest in helping you level up. I love working with people who want to grow, and I'll support you every step of the way

What you'll do



Review all raw footage for each project (both long-form and short-form)

Cut everything unnecessary — dead air, mistakes, weak takes, filler, anything that drags

Keep the best, highest-energy, most interesting moments

Organize your selects clearly and pass them to the lead editor in a ready-to-use state

Maintain a fast turnaround while juggling multiple projects at once



Who you are

description:

The Character Institute is a growing coaching and personal development brand founded by

Coach Chris Christie — a 35-year veteran coach, mentor, and speaker who helps athletes,

coaches, parents, and leaders build the inner foundation that performance alone can never

provide.

We operate across four pillars:

The Ascent Collective — an online community and membership where athletes, coaches,

and leaders do the real work of purpose, identity, and character-driven leadership together.

Leading From Within — a foundational program for athletes and leaders ready to build

confidence, character, and clarity from the inside out.

The Wayfarer Program — a mentoring community built around monthly group discussions,

shared accountability, and a tribe of people asking the same honest questions. (Launching

late 2026.)

Discover Your Compass — a 12-week, 1-on-1 intensive cohort experience where clients

build their personal life roadmap with Chris directly.

We are also active across
, Instagram, TikTok, and host regular live sessions and

webinars. We are growing fast and we are just getting started.

About This Role

This begins as a project-based position — approximately 10 to 15 hours of work — with a

very real and genuine opportunity to grow into a long-term, full-time role as the business

expands through the rest of 2026 and into 2027.

The immediate project is supporting the launch of our “Beyond the Scoreboard” webinar

campaign this Fall — a full digital funnel including landing pages,
 automation, and social

media setup. All content is written, all images are designed, and all copy is ready. We need

someone who can take a complete set of assets and build them into a working system

accurately and efficiently.

But this role is bigger than one campaign. As we grow, we will need ongoing support across all

of our platforms, programs, and community. The right person who does excellent work on this

first project becomes our go-to person for everything that follows.

Immediate Project Scope (10–15 Hours)

Here is exactly what needs to be built for the launch:

1. Kajabi Landing Page — Build a registration landing page using provided copy, images, and

layout instructions. All assets are ready; you are assembling them inside Kajabi’s page

builder.

2. Kajabi Thank You Page — Build a post-registration confirmation page using the same

provided assets.

3.
 Automation Sequence — Load an 11
 sequence into Kajabi’s automation

builder. All
s are written and ready to copy-paste. You will set the correct send delays

and connect the automation to the form trigger.

4. PDF Upload & Delivery — Upload our Character Scorecard PDF to Kajabi and link it in the

confirmation
 so it delivers automatically upon registration.

5. ManyChat Keyword Trigger Setup — Set up a keyword automation in ManyChat on


 and Instagram so that when someone comments a specific word during a live

session, they automatically receive a DM with the landing page link.

6. End-to-End Testing — Test the complete funnel from opt-in to
 delivery to confirm

everything fires correctly before our July launch date.

Ongoing Role (As the Business Grows)

Once the initial project is complete, the right candidate will have the opportunity to take on a

growing set of responsibilities, including:

Social media scheduling and posting —
, Instagram, TikTok (content provided

by Chris; VA schedules and publishes)


 campaign management — ongoing newsletters, promotional
s, and new

automation sequences in Kajabi

(monitoring activity, flagging questions for Chris, welcoming new members)

coordinating replay distribution

launched

and running smoothly

beginning will have a front-row seat — and a meaningful role — in that growth.

What We Provide You

All designed image assets (hero background, scorecard cover, icons)

All 11
s — written, formatted, and ready to paste

The Character Scorecard PDF (the lead magnet)

Direct access to answer any questions during the project

What We Are Looking For

Kajabi experience is required — you must know the platform well. Building landing pages,

setting up automations, and managing
 sequences should be second nature to you.

ManyChat experience — setting up keyword triggers and DM automations on

and Instagram.

Strong attention to detail — you follow instructions precisely and double-check your work

before calling it done.

Reliable communication — you respond promptly, ask clear questions when needed, and

update on progress without being chased.

Self-starter mindset — you can work independently with clear instructions and do not need

to be micromanaged.

scheduling tools (Buffer, Later, or similar), or TikTok content management.

What you will work on

Development of our own platform and CMS

Working with Payload CMS and our custom setup built on top of it

TypeScript

Node.js

Next.js

React

Payload CMS

PostgreSQL

REST / GraphQL APIs

You will get access to Claude Code, and we expect you to use it as much as possible to work faster and better.



However, we are not looking for someone who simply copies AI-generated code.



You must understand the code, be able to make good technical decisions, test your work and take responsibility for the final result.



Who you will work with



You will work closely with one of the company owners, who is also a developer with 20+ years of experience from large and complex development projects.



This means you will have the opportunity to learn, discuss technical solutions, ask questions and develop side by side with someone highly experienced.



We are looking for someone who wants to improve, take responsibility and become a stronger developer over time.

We are looking for someone who is:



A skilled developer

Reliable and honest

Self-driven

Good at solving problems

Able to work independently

Easy to communicate with

Fluent in English

Serious about quality

What matters is that you are good, reliable and able to deliver quality work.



Please do not apply if you are not confident that you can work with the technologies mentioned above. There will be a technical test, so applying without the right skills will only waste your time.



Working hours



This role starts with 4 hours per working day.



Our preferred setup is that you work the same 4 hours each working day within this time window:



11:00–19:00 Central European Time



During your working hours, we expect you to be available for:



Short video calls

Quick check-ins

Questions and feedback

Daily communication



You will also be expected to upload or share your work every day, so we can follow your progress clearly.



Communication



Good communication is very important.



Your English must be fluent enough that we can easily discuss tasks, technical problems, requirements and feedback.



Since this is a remote role, we need someone who is responsive, clear and dependable.



Hiring process



The hiring process includes:



A short unpaid technical test

A fully paid 1-month trial period



The technical test will take a few hours and is used to evaluate your skills, problem-solving and quality of work. The test will be limited in scope and is only used as part of the hiring process.



The first month is a normal paid working month. During this month, we will evaluate whether the communication, quality and working relationship are a good fit.



Long-term opportunity



For the right person, this can become a very strong long-term opportunity.



As the company grows, the role can grow too. There may be an opportunity to move into a full-time position and, in the future, potentially help lead a small development team.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the company and become an important part of what we are building.



Salary

Please include your expected monthly salary for a part-time role of 4 hours per working day in your application.

title: Amazon Product Researcher & Market Expansion Specialist (Helium 10 Experience Required)
description:
About Us:

We are a fast-growing e-commerce brand specializing in stationery. We have a highly successful catalog in the US, and we are rapidly expanding our operations into international marketplaces (Canada, Australia, UK, and the EU). We operate like a well-oiled machine and rely on clear SOPs, strong communication, and data-driven decisions to grow.



The Role:

We are looking for a highly organized and analytical Amazon Product Researcher to act as the "gatekeeper" for our international expansion. Your primary responsibility will be taking our proven, successful US stationery products and validating whether there is enough buyer demand to launch them in international markets.



You will not be guessing—you will be using our exact Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Amazon keyword data, and Helium 10 to make calculated decisions. Once you validate a product, you will document it and hand it off to our logistics team to execute the launch.



Key Responsibilities:



Marketplace Audience Validation: Take our existing US stationery and determine if it is a cultural and data-driven fit for Canada, Australia, the UK, and Europe.



Localized Amazon Search Analysis: Conduct accurate search queries by changing Amazon delivery postcodes to match local target markets.



Competitor & Sales Analysis (Helium 10): Use the Helium 10 Chrome Extension to analyze top organic competitors and verify if they meet our minimum threshold of 5–10 sales per month.



Lateral Keyword Research: Apply our "Gift vs. Stationery" keyword strategy to identify untapped market gaps for niche products.



Tracker Management: Maintain and update our Google Sheets "Product Research Tracker" with clear "Yes/No" launch decisions so the rest of the team (logistics and listing creation) can take over.



Team Collaboration: Communicate clearly with management and tea
mbers via Slack regarding borderline cases and launch pipelines.



Requirements:



Amazon Experience: Proven experience navigating Amazon, doing keyword research, and understanding organic vs. sponsored placements.



Helium 10 Proficiency: You must be highly comfortable using the Helium 10 Chrome Extension (specifically Xray) to evaluate search volume, 30-day sales, and competitor revenue.



Analytical Mindset: You don't just pull data; you know how to interpret it. You can look at search results and accurately judge if a niche is worth entering.



Strong English Skills: Because you will be evaluating English-language stationery products (including humor, slang, and cultural niches), a strong grasp of the English language is essential.



High Attention to Detail: You follow SOPs strictly and maintain perfectly organized spreadsheets.



Why Work With Us?



Clear, step-by-step SOPs so you never have to guess what your job is.



A collaborative, organized team environment.



Steady, reliable work with a growing brand.



How to Apply:

If you read this far and believe you are a great fit for this role, please apply with a brief cover letter outlining your experience with Amazon product research and Helium 10. To prove you have the high attention to detail required for this role, please make the subject line of your application: "Stationery Expansion - [Your Name]".

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term

- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.

- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

• 13th-month service bonus equivalent to one month’s base fee, paid every December.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• 10 days of paid leave per annum after 12 months of service, plus observed Australian public holidays without reduction to your base fee.

• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing dialler, CATI platform, and methodology training so you can perform at the highest level.

• Real ownership of how the floor runs, working directly with senior ANZ leadership — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We run multi-market CATI fieldwork for ANZ and international market research clients, and we’re looking for an experienced operations manager to take ownership of the call floor. You’ll be responsible for fieldwork execution, dialler performance, quota management, and the productivity of our interviewer teams.



This is a senior, deeply hands-on role. You’ll have real autonomy over how the floor runs, but you’re also expected to roll up your sleeves — personally running shifts when needed and working directly with front-line interviewers, not just managing through layers. You’ll be accountable for hitting completion targets, maintaining quality, and keeping projects on budget.



The Hybrid Future — What Makes This Different



Every senior CATI manager knows what’s coming. Voicebots are going to reshape telephone interviewing within the next few years, and operations leaders fall into two camps: those who get sidelined by it, and those who lead the transition. We’re looking for the second kind.



TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that can conduct natural-sounding interviews at scale. Your role in this isn’t theoretical: as the voicebot moves from pilot to production, you’ll be the operational lead running the blended human/voicebot floor. D
 which interviews go to human interviewers and which go to the voicebot. Managing quality across both channels. Calibrating the hybrid model to deliver better data than either could alone.



If you’ve been waiting for a CATI role where you get to shape what telephone research becomes — rather than manage its slow decline — this is it.



What You’ll Do



• Manage CATI fieldwork end-to-end: sample distribution, quota matrices, completion tracking.

• Personally run live shifts when required — this is not a desk-only role. You’ll be on the floor (remotely) directing interviewers in real time, especially during critical fieldwork windows and across time zones.

• Monitor dialler performance in real time — contact rates, call dispositions, interviewer yield — and make tactical calls to keep productivity up.

• Coordinate Shift Supervisors, QA staff, and a remote interviewer pool.

• Troubleshoot operational issues live and work directly with the survey programming team when scripts need adjustments.

• Maintain ISO 20252 / ESOMAR-aligned quality processes.

• Produce daily and weekly operational reporting for the COO.



What We’re Looking For



• 7+ years in CATI operations within a market research agency or fieldwork BPO, with 3+ years in a senior management role.

• Strong working knowledge of dialler logic, CATI platforms, and call centre KPIs.

• Genuinely good with front-line interviewers — you can motivate, coach, and direct base-level interviewers directly, not just manage through supervisors. The best candidates have come up through the floor and haven’t lost the common touch.

• Solid grasp of market research methodology: sampling, quotas, weighting basics, and QA standards (ISO 20252, ESOMAR).

• Forward-looking on AI in research — you don’t need technical AI experience, but you should see voicebots as an opportunity to lead, not a threat to manage around.

• Comfortable with flexible shift patterns to cover multi-timezone fieldwork (agreed in advance — not random).

• Home office with reliable power, dual internet connections, and a setup capable of running monitoring tools and video calls daily.

• Strong written and spoken English.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The largest CATI operation you’ve personally run (team size, markets, sample volumes).

2. The dialler platforms you know best.

3. Your shift flexibility.

4. Your view on how voicebots will reshape telephone interviewing — and where you see your role in that shift.

title: Part-Time Shopify Store Creator (3 Hours/Day) – Long-Term Opportunity
description:
# **Créateur de sites Shopify (Temps partiel – 3 heures par jour / 21 heures par semaine)**



## À propos du poste



Nous recherchons un **créateur de sites Shopify expérimenté** pour rejoindre notre équipe en **temps partiel (3 heures par jour, 7 jours par semaine, soit environ 21 heures par semaine)**.



Notre fonctionnement est simple : nous lançons en moyenne **3 nouveaux produits par semaine** en phase de test. Certaines semaines, il peut y en avoir un peu moins ou un peu plus, mais c'est notre rythme habituel.



Avec une charge de travail de **21 heures par semaine** pour environ **3 produits**, cela représente **environ 7 heures de travail par produit**.



Pour chaque produit, il faudra généralement :



* Recréer une page produit Shopify.

* Recréer un **listicle (page de prévente)**.



Nous estimons que **7 heures sont largement suffisantes** pour réaliser ce travail, puisque dans la majorité des cas il s'agit essentiellement de reproduire le travail d'un concurrent et de l'adapter à notre marque ainsi qu'au marché canadien.



## Vos missions



Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :



* Recréer des pages produits Shopify performantes.

* Remplacer le branding du concurrent par le nôtre (logo, nom de la marque, etc.).

* Recréer des **listicles (pages de prévente)** en reprenant la structure du concurrent.

* Adapter le contenu du marché américain au marché canadien. Cela comprend notamment :



  * Remplacer les prix en dollars américains (USD) par des dollars canadiens (CAD).

  * Adapter les prix sur l'ensemble de la page.

  * Remplacer les villes ou références américaines par des villes canadiennes lorsque cela est pertinent.

* Veiller à ce que chaque page soit professionnelle et aussi fidèle que possible à la mise en page originale.



En résumé, votre travail consistera principalement à **reproduire des pages Shopify et des listicles qui fonctionnent déjà, tout en les adaptant à notre marque et au marché canadien.**



## Outils



Vous utiliserez **ChatGPT Premium**, que nous mettrons à votre disposition. L'intelligence artificielle vous aidera à adapter les textes et à travailler plus rapidement.



## Profil recherché



**Merci de ne pas postuler si :**



* Vous n'avez jamais créé de sites ou de pages produits Shopify.

* Vous ne savez pas recréer une page Shopify existante.

* Vous ne savez pas ce qu'est un **listicle (page de prévente)**.

* Vous n'avez aucune expérience dans la reproduction ou la création de pages Shopify.



La maîtrise de l'anglais **n'est pas obligatoire**, car les outils d'intelligence artificielle, notamment ChatGPT, facilitent énormément le travail. En revanche, avoir un bon niveau d'anglais est un véritable avantage et vous permettra de travailler plus efficacement.



## Ce que nous recherchons



* Une expérience concrète sur Shopify.

* De l'autonomie.

* Un grand souci du détail.

* Une bonne rapidité d'exécution.

* Une personne sérieuse, organisée et fiable.



Si vous avez déjà de l'expérience dans la création de sites Shopify et la reproduction de pages performantes, nous serons ravis d'étudier votre candidature. N'hésitez pas à nous présenter votre expérience lors de votre candidature.

title: Payroll/Bookkeeper - Experienced with Australian Client
description:
About Us

Deryan Financial Group is a family-owned accounting and finance firm with over 40 years of experience helping clients make smarter financial and lending decisions.

We combine the expertise of mortgage broking and accounting to deliver end-to-end solutions — from securing the right loan to optimising tax and business outcomes.

The Opportunity

If you're an experienced tax professional who takes pride in accuracy, organisation, and compliance — this is your opportunity to take ownership of individual and sole trader tax return preparation within our growing accounting division.

You'll manage the end-to-end preparation of individual tax returns and small sole trader tax returns, ensure client files are complete and accurate before lodgement, and maintain compliance with current ATO requirements. You'll work closely with our senior accountants and tax agents, keeping returns moving efficiently through review so the team can focus on advisory and more complex work.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives on structure and precision, and is confident managing a high-volume caseload of individual and sole trader returns from intake through to lodgement.

What You'll Do

• Prepare individual income tax returns, including those with rental properties, capital gains, and multiple income sources.

• Prepare tax returns for small sole trader businesses, including business income and expense schedules.

• Review client-supplied documentation for completeness, following up directly with clients on missing or unclear information.

• Reconcile income, deductions, and expense substantiation against supporting records.

• Prepare returns for senior accountant or tax agent review and sign-off, addressing review queries promptly.

• Lodge completed returns and manage related ATO correspondence and follow-ups.

• Maintain accurate, well-organised client files and tax return administration records.

• Communicate directly with clients regarding outstanding information, return status, and queries.

• Identify and implement process improvements to streamline return preparation and administration.

About You

• 3+ years' experience preparing individual and/or sole trader tax returns in an Australian public practice or tax agent environment (essential).

• Sound working knowledge of individual tax matters — deductions, rental properties, capital gains, and sole trader income and expenses.

• Experience with tax preparation software (e.g. Xero Tax, HandiTax, or similar).

• Confident managing a high-volume caseload with strong attention to deadlines.

• Excellent attention to detail and time management skills.

• Professional communication skills and ability to manage client relationships independently.

• Organised, reliable, and proactive in identifying issues before they arise.

What's on Offer

• Competitive salary based on experience.

• Supportive, professional, and family-oriented team culture.

• Opportunity to build deep expertise in individual and sole trader tax within a multi-disciplinary firm.

• Exposure to a wide range of clients and industries.

title: Customer Service Team Lead (Starting Role) | Health Tech Company | Full-Time Remote
description:
About the role: We're not just another remote job. We're a mission-driven health technology company helping thousands of older Americans reduce chronic pain and avoid unnecessary medications. We're growing fast, and we need someone exceptionally detail-oriented to handle customer service and content tasks using AI tools.



Our customers are older adults (50+) who are often skeptical, technically challenged, and need compassionate, clear communication. You'll be their main point of contact.



This role is 60% customer service, 40% content work.



What you'll actually be doing:



Customer Service (Primary Focus - 60% of time):

- Respond to 20-30 customer inquiries daily 
 & chat) in our ticketing system

- Use Claude AI to draft responses, then critically review and personalize them

- Adapt our
 templates (makros) to each customer's specific situation

- Read full conversation history before responding, context is everything

- Handle returns, warranty cases, medical questions following our protocols

- Know when to escalate vs. handle independently



Content & Marketing (40% of time):

- Write science-backed blog posts with AI assistance (you prompt, proofread, fact-check, optimize)

- Create social media content with Canva (using our templates)

- Schedule posts and engage with our audience

- Reach out to health & wellness influencers for partnerships (80% automated already)



Critical requirements (no exceptions):

- 5+ years of customer service experience (preferably in health, wellness, or medical devices)

- Near-native English (our customers are American seniors)

- Proven experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.). You should already be using AI in your current work

- Experience with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello etc)

- Obsessive attention to detail. You catch mistakes others miss

- Fast learner who takes notes and doesn't repeat mistakes

- Excellent internet connection and professional workspace



You'll struggle in this role if you:

- Copy-paste AI responses without critical thinking

- Don't read full context before responding

- Tend to make the same mistake over and over again

- Need constant supervision

- Work multiple jobs and can't focus



What makes someone successful here:

- Read full context before responding (you're thorough, not rushed)

- Customize templates thoughtfully (not copy-paste)

- Think critically about whether your responses make sense

- Take pride in helping people solve real problems

- Want to build something, not just clock hours

- See feedback as a gift, not criticism

- You work independently but know when to ask for help



What makes this opportunity different:

- Career growth path: We're hiring for a Customer Service Specialist today, but we're building toward a Customer Service Team Lead role. As we scale, the right person will lead our support team, train new hires, and shape our customer experience strategy. 

- Competitive compensation: $1,000 - $1,200/month USD for full-time (40 hours/week) with true growth potential.

- Paid time off: 15 days paid annual leave (includes public holidays, you choose when to take them).

- Professional development: Access to courses, AI tools, and direct mentorship from our founder. We invest in people who invest in themselves.

- Flexible schedule (must overlap at least 3 hours with Thailand time)

- Process-driven company with comprehensive training with documentation, videos, and daily feedback

- Cutting-edge tools: You'll work with the latest AI technology. This isn't data entry, you're learning skills that will be valuable for years to come.

- Meaningful work: Our customers are grandparents who want to play with their grandkids without pain, veterans managing injuries, people avoiding opioids. Your work directly improves lives.

- Stability with a startup: We're profitable, growing steadily, and been in business for 3 years. You get startup opportunity without the risk.



Our hiring process:

1) Video application (3-5 min) - see questions below

2) Video interview (30 min) - we'll get to know you, answer your questions & test your thinking

3) Paid trial task (4 hours, $50) - customer service scenarios to filter for skills. Tests attention to detail, AI usage, customer service judgment

4) Trial week (20 hours, $160) - Work with real tickets. We will filter for learning ability & work ethic.

5) Probation month ($1,000) - for both of us to understand whether we're a good fit



This is a high bar. We've had candidates with 10+ years of experience not work out because they lacked attention to detail and didn't learn from mistakes. If you're not someone who naturally catches details and learns quickly, this isn't the right fit.



To apply, create a video (Use Loom, Dubb or similar tools) answering these questions:

1) Customer service experience: Tell me about your experience (years, industry etc) and mention one of the most challenging tickets you worked on and how you resolved it.

2) AI usage: How do you currently use AI in your work? Be specific with tools and tasks

3) Why you: Let us know why you think we should choose you over other candidates



Your video should be max 5 minutes. Applications without video will be automatically rejected.

title: LinkedIn Outreach Specialist
description:
The Role

We are looking for a highly strategic, results-driven LinkedIn Outreach Specialist to join our team at Penji. Your primary mission is simple but challenging: turn cold LinkedIn connections into booked calendar meetings and drive our growth forward.

We don’t want someone who just clicks "connect" and relies on generic, automated spam. We need a skilled conversationalist who understands B2B networking, knows how to bypass the noise, and can build immediate, authentic rapport with our target audience.

Who we sell to: Our outreach targets sales and marketing leaders and decision-makers at companies in the design and marketing space. You’ll be working from a target list and persona we provide — your job is to execute that strategy with precision and find the messaging angles that get this specific audience to respond.



Logistics

• Type: Full-time

• Location: Remote

• Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Philippine Time



Your Key Objectives (The KPIs)

You are coming in to solve a specific problem: filling our pipeline. Your success will be measured by:

• Scheduling 10 Qualified Demos Per Week: This is your primary North Star. Every action you take should drive toward this number.

• Maintaining a High, Steadily Improving Response Rate: We’re aggressive about our goals, but we also believe in a realistic ramp-up so you can calibrate messaging and targeting before scaling:

? Month 1: 15–20% (calibration phase — testing copy, targeting, and offer)

? Month 2: 25–30%

? Month 3 onward: 35%+, with 50% as our stretch ceiling for top-performing segments/campaigns

Your mandate is to ruthlessly A/B test, refine targeting, and optimize copy to push toward these numbers.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Outbound Messaging: Craft personalized, engaging connection requests and follow-up sequences based on the target lists and personas we provide.

• Inbox Management & Triage: Handle responses dynamically. Overcome objections, answer initial questions, and seamlessly pivot conversations toward a booked demo.

• Iterative Optimization: Test, tweak, and figure out the exact messaging angles that convert our specific audience. You own the process within the strategy we set.

• Personal Brand & Engagement: Post and engage consistently on your own LinkedIn account (posts, comments, thoughtful engagement with prospects’ content) to build visibility and warmth with our target audience — this engagement is itself a channel for getting responses and booked demos, not just outreach messages alone.

• Continuous Learning: Stay open to testing new strategies, tactics, and skills (new messaging frameworks, engagement techniques, tools) as we work together to push booking numbers higher. We don’t expect you to have it all figured out on day one — we expect you to keep iterating.



Who You Are

• Experienced: You have a proven track record of booking B2B meetings specifically through LinkedIn outreach.

• Tool-Savvy: You’re comfortable working across LinkedIn’s professional tools and CRMs (e.g., Sales Navigator, Dripify, Hey Reach, or similar outreach/sequencing platforms), and you’re quick to pick up new tools as our stack evolves.

• A Strategic Thinker: You don’t need hand-holding. Given a target list and a goal, you know how to figure out the “how” to get there.

• Copywriting Sharpness: You know how to write concise, punchy messages that get decision-makers to actually hit “reply.”

• Fluent in English: Excellent written communication skills with a firm grasp of a professional, conversational business tone.



Requirements

• 1,000+ LinkedIn connections, with meaningful overlap in B2B/SaaS, design, or marketing industries (we may ask for a screenshot of your network breakdown — visible under “My Network” on LinkedIn — as part of your application).

• A LinkedIn account in good standing: no recent restrictions, a complete profile, and an active posting/engagement history.



How to Apply

(Magic Phrase: conversational)

To ensure your application stands out:

1. Complete the application form:

2. Attach your portfolio or relevant work samples.

title: Reddit Karma Farmer / Account Warmer
description:
We're a small digital marketing agency that maintains a network of Reddit accounts used for marketing campaigns. We're looking for a full-time VA who is a genuine Reddit user and can keep accounts active, credible, and karma-ready following a structured daily system.



What this job actually is:

This is account warming and karma farming — not marketing copywriting. You will be logging into assigned accounts, building karma through genuine participation, and keeping accounts healthy and ready for future use. Once an account reaches the required stage, you'll begin commenting and posting in a specific set of target subreddits following clear guidelines. No promotional content, no links, no brand mentions — that's handled separately.



What you'll do:



• Browse and engage on assigned accounts daily using a provided browser tool



• Build karma naturally through genuine comments and posts in assigned subreddits



• Follow a clear stage-based system that tells you exactly what each account can and can't do each day



• Log daily activity in a shared tracker



• Flag any account issues immediately



What we're looking for:



Active Reddit user — required. You need to know how karma works, how to write a comment that gets upvoted, and how different subreddits behave. We are not teaching Reddit basics.



Strong written English — comments must read like a real user, not AI



Detail-oriented, consistent, and able to follow a system without cutting corners



Reliable daily availability — account consistency is critical



Own computer and stable internet



To apply, answer all three — incomplete applications will not be reviewed:



1. Do you use Reddit personally? What subreddits are you active in, how long have you been on the platform, and what's your approximate karma?



2. Describe a job where you followed a detailed daily process or checklist. How did you stay consistent?



3. Write a 3–4 sentence Reddit comment responding to: "Does using a privacy-focused browser actually matter if your ISP can still see everything?"— as a real Reddit user.

description:
Who We Are

Track and report performance — set up goal tracking, site tracking, and event tracking; build dashboards; and translate metrics into clear recommendations.

Continuously optimize existing programs for higher engagement, lower churn, and stronger revenue attribution.



What You Bring



3+ years of hands-on ActiveCampaign experience building complex automations and campaigns (please be prepared to show examples).

Deep command of automations, segmentation, conditional content, and lead scoring.

Proven deliverability expertise — you understand what protects a sender reputation and what destroys it.

Strong grasp of
 marketing metrics and the discipline to test, measure, and iterate.

Excellent written English and clear, proactive communication.

Direct experience in travel, hospitality, vacation rentals, or resorts.

You care about the numbers because they represent real bookings, real revenue, and real trust from our clients. Long-term, stable engagement for the right person.

What Success Looks Like

-Providers are credentialed and enrolled without delays

-All records are accurate, complete, and audit-ready

-Payer enrollments are tracked, followed up, and completed on time

-Credentialing issues do not impact billing or claims



Core Responsibilities



1. Credentialing Execution

-Manage full lifecycle credentialing for providers from onboarding to re-credentialing

-Perform primary source verification for licenses, education, certifications, and work history

-Ensure compliance with payer and regulatory standards such as NCQA and CMS

2. Payer Enrollment Management

-Prepare, submit, and track applications with commercial and government payers

-Work within payer portals including CAQH and PECOS

-Monitor application status, effective dates, and panel participation

-Ensure providers are correctly linked to group entities to avoid billing issues



3. Data Ownership & Tracking

-Maintain a centralized tracker for credentialing status, expirables, and deadlines

-Keep provider data updated across all systems and platforms

• Lead management and sales pipeline workflows

• C# / .NET

mbers

 that includes:

title: Performance Marketer (AI-Augmented),
description:
We're Closers Cult, the high-ticket sales coaching business built by Orlando Santucci. Our organic marketing is growing fast. We pull between 200,000 and 600,000 organic reach every month and get hundreds of inquiries on their own, without spending a cent on them. The top of our funnel works.



The problem is our paid ads. The tracking is broken, the account is messy, and we're leaving money on the table. We want our paid marketing, and honestly the rest of the marketing engine, built to support and scale the organic that's already flying.



We want one person to own all of it and make it work.



This is a small team. You'll work directly with Orlando and me. We move fast and we don't do meetings for the sake of meetings. If you're good, you'll get a lot of room to run.

Data and tracking optimisation. Everything must be tracked, measured and analysed to inform decisions.

Run our Meta ads day to day. We make the creative for you. You structure the campaigns, manage the budget, and d
 what to scale and what to switch off.

Build out
 and SMS to follow up the leads and inquiries we already get and book more calls.

We run almost everything through Claude. You don't need to be a coder, but you do need to be genuinely good with AI and use it every day. The best person for this job gets the output of three people out of AI, and knows when the AI is wrong.



What you need



Real experience running Meta ads, your own money or a client's. You can show us accounts and results.

You know pixels, the conversions API, and event tracking. You can spot when tracking is broken and fix it yourself.

title: Customer Service Team Lead (Starting Role) | Health Tech Company | Full-Time Remote
description:
About the role: We're not just another remote job. We're a mission-driven health technology company helping thousands of older Americans reduce chronic pain and avoid unnecessary medications. We're growing fast, and we need someone exceptionally detail-oriented to handle customer service and content tasks using AI tools.



Our customers are older adults (50+) who are often skeptical, technically challenged, and need compassionate, clear communication. You'll be their main point of contact.



This role is 70% customer service, 30% content & administrative work.



What you'll actually be doing:



Customer Service (Primary Focus - 70% of time):

- Respond to 20-30 customer inquiries daily 
 & chat) in our ticketing system

- Use Claude AI to draft responses, then critically review and personalize them

- Adapt our
 templates (makros) to each customer's specific situation

- Read full conversation history before responding, context is everything

- Handle returns, warranty cases, medical questions following our protocols

- Know when to escalate vs. handle independently



Content & Marketing (40% of time):

- Write science-backed blog posts with AI assistance (you prompt, proofread, fact-check, optimize)

- Create social media content with Canva (using our templates)

- Schedule posts and engage with our audience



Critical requirements (no exceptions):

- 5+ years of customer service experience

- Near-native English (our customers are American seniors)

- Proven experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.). You should already be using AI in your current work

- Experience with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello etc)

- Obsessive attention to detail. You catch mistakes others miss

- Fast learner who takes notes and doesn't repeat mistakes

- Excellent internet connection and professional workspace



You'll struggle in this role if you:

- Copy-paste AI responses without critical thinking

- Don't read full context before responding

- Tend to make the same mistake over and over again

- Need constant supervision

- Work multiple jobs and can't focus



What makes someone successful here:

- Read full context before responding (you're thorough, not rushed)

- Customize templates thoughtfully (not copy-paste)

- Think critically about whether your responses make sense

- Take pride in helping people solve real problems

- Want to build something, not just clock hours

- See feedback as a gift, not criticism

- You work independently but know when to ask for help



What makes this opportunity different:

- Career growth path: We're hiring for a Customer Service Specialist today, but we're building toward a Customer Service Team Lead role. As we scale, the right person will lead our support team, train new hires, and shape our customer experience strategy.

- Competitive compensation: $800 - $1,200/month USD based on experience for full-time (40 hours/week) with true growth potential.

- Paid time off: 15 days paid annual leave (includes public holidays, you choose when to take them).

- Professional development: Access to courses, AI tools, and direct mentorship from our founder. We invest in people who invest in themselves.

- Flexible schedule (must overlap at least 3 hours with Thailand time)

- Process-driven company with comprehensive training with documentation, videos, and daily feedback

- Cutting-edge tools: You'll work with the latest AI technology. This isn't data entry, you're learning skills that will be valuable for years to come.

- Meaningful work: Our customers are grandparents who want to play with their grandkids without pain, veterans managing injuries, people avoiding opioids. Your work directly improves lives.

- Stability with a startup: We're profitable, growing steadily, and been in business for 3 years. You get startup opportunity without the risk.



Our hiring process:

1) Video application (3-5 min) - see questions below

2) Video interview (30 min) - we'll get to know you, answer your questions & test your thinking

3) Trial week (20 hours, $160) - Work with real tickets. We will filter for learning ability & work ethic.

4) Probation month ($1,000) - for both of us to understand whether we're a good fit



This is a high bar. We've had candidates with 10+ years of experience not work out because they lacked attention to detail and didn't learn from mistakes. If you're not someone who naturally catches details and learns quickly, this isn't the right fit.



To apply, create a video (Use Loom, Dubb or similar tools) answering these questions:

1) Customer service experience: Tell me about your experience (years, industry etc) 

2) Explain the most challenging tickets you worked on and how you resolved it.

3) AI usage: How do you currently use AI in your work? Be specific with tools and tasks

4) Why you: Let us know why you think we should choose you over other candidates



Your video should be max 5 minutes. Applications without video will be automatically rejected. Please don't read from a script written by AI. We want to hear from you about your experience, not an AI polished version. It's easy to detect.

This is not a junior social media role.

 marketing campaigns.

Brevo or similar
 marketing platforms.

Improving brand visibility and market positioning.

Strong
 marketing experience.

Details of
 marketing, CRM, campaign, website or social media work you have managed.

 marketing experience.

.

title: Creator Partnerships Manager
description:
Context

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand ready to invest seriously in creator marketing. We're looking for an experienced Influencer Marketing Manager to own the entire strategy and execution — from identifying the right creators to managing relationships and tracking results. This is not a one-off task: we want someone who becomes our go-to expert on this subject.



What you'll do



Strategy:

- Build and recommend a creator marketing strategy tailored to our brand (gifting, paid collabs, partnership ads, affiliates, UGC)

- Set up and scale partnership ads and creator white-listing (allowlisting) — running paid ads directly through creators' own handles

- Define the right creator profiles to target and the best platforms to focus on

- Advise us on best practices, benchmarks, and what actually works



Sourcing & research:

- Identify and build qualified lists of relevant creators (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.), manually and in targeted geographic areas

- Currently focused on the UK market, with the potential to expand to other regions later on

- Collect key data points: handle,
, follower count, engagement rate, niche, location, and more

- Filter and qualify profiles independently based on your understanding of our brand



Outreach & relationship management:

- Handle all first contact with creators

- Manage the full conversation: follow-ups, negotiation, briefing, and closing deals

- Build lasting creator relationships and turn one-off collaborations into long-term brand ambassadors

- Maintain an up-to-date tracking sheet with the status of each creator at all times



Campaign execution & reporting:

- Coordinate gifting shipments, paid collaborations, and content deliveries

- Brief creators to create natural, authentic content we can repurpose across our paid ads

- Monitor campaign performance and KPIs every day, and share regular updates and insights

- Make recommendations based on results to continuously improve our approach



Who we're looking for:

- Experience in influencer marketing, creator relations, or UGC campaigns

- Has managed campaigns end-to-end, not just one part of the process

- Hands-on experience with partnership ads and white-listing — a key area we'll be scaling soon

- Knows the creator ecosystem inside out — you can spot a great fit for a brand without being told every criteria

- A genuine feel for our audience — modest, faith-led, community-driven — and the instinct to spot creators who resonate authentically, not just by follower count

- Experienced with outreach and negotiation with creators of all sizes

- Comfortable building and maintaining tracking systems (Google Sheets or equivalent)

- Familiar with scraping or data tools to source creators at scale (at least 40 per day)

- Autonomous, proactive, and able to bring ideas to the table — we want an expert, not an executor

- Reliable and consistent, available during our core working hours (9am–6pm) and responsive by message throughout the day

, phone, LinkedIn)

Skills:

This is a full-time remote role based in the Philippines.

Commitment: Full-time, Philippine business hours (Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm PHT) with flexibility for supplier updates outside standard hours)

title: Finance & Accounting Coordinator
description:
About the Role:

New Beginnings Moving & Hauling is looking for a sharp, detail-driven part-time finance coordinator to keep the money side of the business clean and current — invoices out on time, receivables chased, books up to date, and a clear monthly picture for the owner. This is a focused, behind-the-scenes seat built for someone who lives in QuickBooks and catches the small errors before they become big ones. It is not a management or customer-facing role.



Core Responsibilities:

Same-day invoicing. Make sure an invoice goes out the same day every job is completed — no lag between work done and the customer being billed.

Accounts receivable follow-up. Run a consistent past-due chase at 3, 7, and 14 days, escalating tone appropriately at each step and surfacing accounts that aren't responding.

Expense tracking in QuickBooks. Enter and correctly categorize every expense so reports stay accurate and tax prep is painless.

Payroll timesheet review. Check timesheets for discrepancies — missing punches, overlaps, unusual hours — and flag them. (This role reviews and flags; it does not process payroll directly.)

Recurring billing & monthly summary. Bill recurring monthly contracts on schedule and prepare a simple monthly financial summary for the owner.



Could Also Own (scope permitting within ~10 hrs/week):

Bank & credit card reconciliation — match QuickBooks against statements monthly so the books are trustworthy.

Fuel card reconciliation — match fuel card charges against the fleet log and receipts, and flag anything that doesn't line up (the company runs monthly fuel card audits — this role is a natural fit to support them).

Tip payout reconciliation — verify the twice-weekly tip payouts match the jobs actually completed each work week.

Accounts payable — track and schedule vendor and supplier bills so nothing goes late.

Payment application & deposits — apply incoming customer payments to the right invoices and keep the deposit record clean.

CPA / tax prep support — organize year-end documents, contractor 1099s, and sales-tax figures for handoff to the company's accountant.

Light financial reporting — track simple health metrics like average days-to-pay (DSO) and an AR aging snapshot to include in the monthly summary.



Ideal Candidate:

Must have: Strong QuickBooks familiarity, genuine attention to detail, reliability with deadlines.

Nice to have: Bookkeeping or small-business accounting background, comfort with spreadsheets, prior experience reconciling accounts.

Not required: Management or customer-facing experience — the part-time scope is deliberately narrow.

title: RFP & Proposals Manager
description:
KENTECH Consulting Inc.



This is a high-impact role where your work directly supports revenue growth and competitive wins. As the RFP & Proposals Manager, you will own the full proposal lifecycle and help position KENTECH to secure complex, high-value opportunities.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Own the full RFP lifecycle from opportunity review and win strategy through drafting, submission, and post-submission follow-up



Partner with leadership to align proposals with revenue goals, competitive positioning, and client priorities



Manage timelines and stakeholders, ensuring proposals are accurate, compliant, and submitted on time



Develop and refine proposal content that is persuasive, client-focused, and aligned with RFP requirements



Leverage AI and automation tools to streamline workflows, manage content libraries, and improve efficiency



Coordinate with clients, partners, and subcontractors during the proposal process as needed



Track outcomes and performance, including win/loss data, and continuously improve the proposal process



What We’re Looking For



3+ years of experience in RFP management, proposal development, business development, or bids and tenders



Demonstrated success using persuasive writing and sales strategy to win contracts



Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines



Experience working cross-functionally with leadership, sales, and operations teams



Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace



Experience with proposal management tools, project management software, or AI tools is a plus



Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, or a related field preferred



Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment



Why This Role Matters



This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and growth. You will directly influence how KENTECH competes, how we tell our story, and how we win new business.
